About the job

Company Description Prodigio IA helps Mexican small and medium-sized businesses integrate artificial intelligence into their daily operations in a practical, results-oriented way. The team designs bootcamps, role-specific training, and internal systems to automate repetitive tasks, improve processes, reduce errors, and save time. Prodigio IA works closely with executive, commercial, administrative, and operational teams to create AI solutions tailored to real use cases in each company. The company prioritizes hands-on implementation over theory, aiming for visible improvements from the first day of collaboration.




Role Description The AI Marketing Intern is a part time, hybrid role based in San Pedro Garza García, NLE. This role supports the marketing team in promoting AI solutions to Mexican SMEs through content creation for social media (Meta, Linked In and others), campaign support. Day-to-day tasks include assisting with market research, helping design and execute marketing strategies, preparing sales and promotional materials, and supporting customer communication and follow-up. title: Growth Analyst
description:
About the job

En Rabbit buscamos a nuestro/a próximo/a Growth Analyst




Esta posición formará parte del equipo de Growth y tendrá un rol clave en la ejecución y seguimiento de campañas digitales que impulsan la adopción, recompra y engagement de nuestros usuarios.




Buscamos una persona organizada, analítica y orientada al detalle, con interés en CRM, Customer Engagement y Marketing Automation, que quiera desarrollarse en un entorno digital de alta transaccionalidad.




🎯 Tu misión




Asegurar la correcta configuración, ejecución y monitoreo de campañas y flujos automatizados de comunicación, garantizando una experiencia relevante para nuestros usuarios y una operación eficiente de los canales digitales.




📌 Responsabilidades principales




• Configurar y programar campañas de comunicación en plataformas de CRM y Customer Engagement.

• Ejecutar pruebas A/B y dar seguimiento a sus resultados.

• Crear y administrar audiencias y segmentaciones para campañas de engagement y recompra.

• Monitorear indicadores de desempeño, entregabilidad y funcionamiento de los canales de comunicación.

• Dar seguimiento a eventos, flujos automatizados e incidencias dentro de las plataformas.

• Colaborar con equipos de Growth, Retención y Negocio para asegurar la correcta ejecución de campañas.

• Apoyar en la generación de reportes y seguimiento de métricas clave.




✅ Requisitos




• Licenciatura concluida.

• 1 a 3 años de experiencia en CRM, Marketing Automation, Customer Engagement o áreas afines.

• Inglés avanzado.

• Atención al detalle y capacidad de organización.

• Interés por el análisis de datos y la optimización de campañas digitales.




💻 Conocimientos técnicos




• Experiencia con herramientas como Braze, CleverTap, MoEngage, Insider o Salesforce Marketing Cloud (deseable).

• Conocimiento de plataformas de analítica como GA4, Mixpanel o Amplitude.

• Configuración de campañas, journeys y automatizaciones.

• Entendimiento básico de APIs, Webhooks y lógica condicional.

• SQL básico (deseable).




🌟 Habilidades clave




• Atención al detalle.

• Pensamiento lógico.

• Sentido de urgencia.

• Comunicación efectiva.

• Trabajo en equipo.

• Curiosidad y aprendizaje continuo.




📍 Ubicación: Santa Fe, Ciudad de México

🕒 Horario: Lunes a jueves 8:30 am a 5:30 pm | Viernes 8:30 am a 2:30 pm

💼 Ofrecemos: Un entorno dinámico, aprendizaje constante y la oportunidad de desarrollarte dentro de un equipo enfocado en crecimiento y experiencia del cliente.




Si cumples con el perfil y te interesa desarrollarte en Growth, CRM y Marketing Automation, te invitamos a postularte adjuntando tu CV a la postulación.

About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

The Passenger Growth team owns the full user lifecycle across DiDi's SSL markets — new user acquisition, first-trip conversion, early lifecycle engagement, churned user reactivation, coupon and discount strategy, and the referral program. We operate across five markets (MX, AR, CO, CL, CR) with distinct constraint profiles, and our terminal metric is 28-day call volume per cohort.

We work cross-functionally with Paid Marketing, Product, Ops/Supply, and Business Development. Our edge is diagnostic accuracy — knowing where growth is being lost, why, and which lever is the correct response as well as operational excellence.

About the job

Job Summary

EL EQUIPO

El equipo de Marketing Digital es el motor creativo y estratégico que posiciona los eventos en las plataformas más relevantes. Diseñamos campañas digitales que generan awareness, tráfico y conversión, trabajando de la mano con promotores y plataformas globales.

DESCRIPCIÓN DEL CARGO

Como Trafficker Digital, serás responsable de implementar y dar seguimiento a campañas en plataformas como Meta, Google, Spotify y TikTok, asegurando que cada acción esté alineada con la estrategia y el presupuesto aprobado. Tu rol será clave para maximizar el impacto de nuestras campañas y garantizar resultados medibles.

Estamos en un momento emocionante: la industria del entretenimiento en vivo está creciendo y Ticketmaster lidera esta transformación con estrategias digitales innovadoras. Este puesto te permitirá trabajar con grandes marcas, plataformas globales y eventos que marcan tendencia.

LO QUE HARÁS


Implementar campañas digitales en plataformas como Meta, Google, Spotify, TikTok y plataformas de Programatic.
Monitorear y controlar la correcta ejecución de campañas según presupuesto y estrategia.

Interactuar con ejecutivos de plataformas digitales para resolver dudas y explorar mejoras.

VIDA EN TICKETMASTER

Nos enorgullece formar parte de Live Nation Entertainment, la empresa de

entretenimiento en vivo más grande del mundo. Nuestra visión en Ticketmaster es

conectar a las personas alrededor del mundo con los eventos en vivo que aman.

Como el mercado de boletos más grande del mundo y el proveedor global líder de

herramientas y servicios para la industria del entretenimiento en vivo, estamos en una

posición única para cumplir con esa visión.

Lo hacemos todo con una pasión intensa por el entretenimiento en vivo y una cultura inspiradora y diversa, impulsada por líderes accesibles, gerentes atentos y equipos entusiastas. Si te apasiona el entretenimiento en vivo como a nosotros, y deseas trabajar en una empresa dedicada a ayudar a millones de fanáticos a vivir esa experiencia, queremos saber de ti.

OPORTUNIDADES IGUALES

Estamos apasionados y comprometidos con nuestra gente, y vamos más allá de la retórica sobre diversidad e inclusión. Trabajarás en un entorno inclusivo y se te alentará a ser tú mismo en el trabajo. Haremos todo lo posible para ayudarte a equilibrar exitosamente tu vida laboral y personal. About the job

About Roveia Health

Roveia Health is a specialized growth marketing agency for telehealth, health & wellness, and digital health brands. Founded by alumni from Meta and Tesla, we help companies in the telehealth, supplements, med spa, and patient acquisition space scale through performance-driven advertising and conversion-optimized systems.




We manage millions in monthly ad spend across Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, and LinkedIn — and we own the retention engine that turns that spend into repeat patients and lifetime value.

Fully remote. Globally distributed. Built to drive real patient and customer growth.




Key Hiring Notes

Must be willing to start within 1-2 weeks
Working Timezone: PT, MT, or CT
Contractor Full Time




The Role

We're hiring a Lifecycle & Retention Marketing Lead to own email and SMS strategy and execution across a portfolio of telehealth and health & wellness client accounts.




You own the retention engine end to end: you set the email/SMS strategy for new clients, build the lifecycle flows and promotional calendar, write the copy, and brief designers to bring campaigns to life. You're fluent in Customer IO and Omnisend, with working knowledge of Klaviyo, and you know how to pull audiences and segments from CRMs and other data platforms to power precise, high-converting sends.




This is a compliance-critical role. You're working with health and telehealth brands, so you understand the guardrails around messaging regulated products — consent, opt-in/opt-out management, TCPA/CASL, CAN-SPAM, and platform-specific health messaging policies. You know how to write and ship campaigns that convert without putting the client at risk.




Agency experience is required. You've managed multiple client accounts, juggled competing timelines, and taken ownership of retention outcomes. This role operates on North American business hours, so strong timezone overlap with our US and Canada teams is expected.




What You'll Own




Strategy & Client Onboarding

Set the email/SMS and lifecycle strategy for new clients — audit their stack, map the funnel, and define the retention roadmap
Translate client goals into a lifecycle plan: onboarding, retention, winback, and promotional programs
Own the strategic direction of retention across your accounts, not just execution

Lifecycle & Automation

Pull and build segments from CRMs and other platforms to drive precise targeting and personalization
Manage automation logic, triggers, and segmentation across Customer.io, Omnisend, and Klaviyo

Campaign Execution & Copywriting

Plan and run promotional emails and blasts on a monthly cadence across your account portfolio
Write high-converting copy — subject lines, body, and CTAs — that's on-brand and compliant
Create clear, detailed briefs for designers to produce email creative, and manage the review-to-ship process

Compliance & Deliverability

Ensure every send meets consent, opt-in/opt-out, and regulatory requirements (TCPA, CASL, CAN-SPAM) and platform health messaging policies
Manage list hygiene, sender reputation, deliverability, and inbox placement
Maintain audit-ready documentation of consent and subscriber management

Testing, Reporting & Communication

Run A/B tests across subject lines, send times, offers, and flow logic
Report on retention KPIs — open/click, conversion, revenue per recipient, LTV, churn, list growth
Communicate performance drivers and learnings to account managers and leads




What We're Looking For




Must-Haves

2–4 years of hands-on email/SMS or lifecycle marketing experience
Agency background is required — you've managed multiple client accounts simultaneously
Hands-on expertise in Customer.io and Omnisend; working knowledge of Klaviyo
Proven ability to build and pull segments from CRMs and other data platforms

Data-driven, detail-oriented, and self-directed
Fluent English, written and verbal




Strong Signals

Has owned retention programs generating meaningful revenue per recipient / LTV lift
Comfortable with deliverability troubleshooting and inbox placement
Experience with subscription or membership retention models
Familiarity with GA4, attribution, and connecting retention data back to acquisition
Experience briefing and directing designers on email creative




You're Not the Right Fit If:

You've only ever run one-off blasts, not lifecycle strategy and automation

You can't write your own copy

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

Job Title: Marketing & Creative Coordinator

Bring great design to life and help shape a brand people remember.

Join a high-performing, design-driven real estate team with decades of experience representing premium properties in one of the world's most iconic cities. Known for its relationship-first approach, attention to detail, and elevated marketing standards, the team believes that every piece of creative work should be intentional, polished, and memorable.

This role goes far beyond creating graphics. You'll play a key role in maintaining the visual identity of the brand across print, digital, social media, email, and web. Working closely with the team, you'll help bring every property to market with a thoughtful, editorial approach while ensuring every touchpoint reflects a consistent and high-quality brand experience. Design high-quality listing collateral, including brochures, flyers, postcards, signage, and digital marketing assets.

Independently identify creative challenges and develop thoughtful, effective solutions with minimal supervision.

Strong proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator (Canva-only experience is not sufficient).

Excellent visual design skills with the ability to produce polished, professional marketing materials.
Video editing experience.
Ability to work independently with minimal oversight while consistently delivering high-quality work.




Nice-to-Have Requirements

Experience with campaign strategy or content planning beyond graphic design.
Previous experience in real estate or luxury/lifestyle brands.
Familiarity with AI-assisted design tools.




Why Join Us

If you're passionate about thoughtful design and enjoy creating marketing that stands out for all the right reasons, this is an opportunity to make a real impact. You'll join a collaborative, design-focused team that values creativity, high standards, and attention to detail while giving you the autonomy to own your work.

Every project is an opportunity to elevate a premium brand, build a cohesive visual identity, and contribute to meaningful marketing that reflects quality over quantity. If you're looking for a role where your creative judgment is trusted and your work truly shapes how a brand is experienced, we'd love to hear from you.

Commercial Landscaping Business | Remote via ScaleSource | Bilingual English/Spanish


Do you think you are a fit for this role but decided not to apply? Please tell us why.

About Us

We are a growing commercial landscaping company serving property managers, HOAs, multifamily communities, retail centers, office parks, business owners, and other commercial clients.

Yes, we mow grass, clean beds, trim shrubs, fix irrigation, handle seasonal color, and keep properties looking sharp.

But the real business we are in is trust.

Our clients are busy. They do not want to babysit their landscaping company. They do not want to send the same email three times. They do not want vague updates. They do not want “let me check on that” followed by silence.

They want someone who owns the issue, communicates clearly, follows through, and makes their life easier.

That is what this role is for.

We are hiring a Client Success / Customer Experience Lead who can help us build a client experience that is way better than what most local service businesses deliver.

This is a remote role through ScaleSource, but this is not a low-level assistant role. This is a leadership-level communication, execution, and follow-up seat.

You will be expected to think, lead, solve, track, follow up, and make sure things actually get done.

If you need to be told every step, this is not the role.

If you see problems, organize chaos, chase answers, communicate clearly, and make sure the ball does not get dropped, you may be exactly who we need.

The Big Picture

Our Standard Is Simple:

No client should ever have to wonder where something stands.

If a client has a question, complaint, issue, request, project update, scheduling concern, irrigation problem, billing question, or property concern, we need that item captured, clarified, assigned, tracked, updated, and completed.

Our goal is that most client issues or requests are resolved within 72 hours or less.

Next day is better.

Same day is beautiful.

But even when something cannot be solved immediately, the client should still receive clear, honest, proactive updates so they know we are on it.

We do not need someone who says, “I passed the message along.”

We Need Someone Who Says:

“I found the issue, confirmed who owns it, tracked the next step, updated the client, followed up with operations, and confirmed it was completed.”

That is the difference.

Role Mission

Your mission is to help us deliver world-class communication and client experience in a business where things move fast, weather changes plans, crews are in the field, clients have urgent needs, and details can easily get lost.

You will be the person helping make sure they do not get lost.

You will work between clients, field leadership, operations, admin, and ownership to make sure communication is clear and execution is tracked.

You are not just answering emails.

You are helping lead the customer experience.

What You’ll Own1. Client Communication

You will communicate with commercial clients through email, phone, text, client portals, CRM systems, video updates, and virtual meetings.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Responding to client messages quickly and professionally
Sending clear updates before clients have to chase us
Explaining what happened, what we are doing, who is responsible, and when the next update will happen
Communicating delays, weather issues, scheduling changes, property concerns, and service updates
Making clients feel heard without overpromising nonsense we cannot deliver
Keeping communication honest, calm, warm, and professional
Making us feel like the most organized landscaping company they have ever worked with


The goal is not to sound fancy.

The goal is to be clear, useful, trustworthy, and fast.


 Issue Ownership and 72-Hour Follow-Through


When a client reports an issue, you do not just forward it and hope someone handles it.

You own the communication loop until the item is completed.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Capturing the issue clearly
Asking good questions when the request is vague
Confirming property, location, priority, photos, timing, and client expectation
Assigning or escalating the issue to the correct internal person
Tracking the status until completion
Following up with operations or field leadership
Updating the client proactively
Confirming completion with notes, photos, or internal confirmation when possible
Closing the loop so everyone knows the issue was handled


Our standard is that client asks and issues should be completed or clearly moved forward within 72 hours whenever possible.

If something will take longer, the client still gets a real update.

No disappearing.

No vague “checking on it.”

No black holes.


 Problem Identification and Solutions


This role requires leadership judgment.

You should be able to identify patterns and problems before they become bigger problems.

For Example:


A client keeps asking about the same issue
A property keeps having the same service complaint
A crew keeps missing the same detail
A work order is stuck with no update
A client has not heard from us in too long
A property manager seems frustrated even if they are being polite
A process is clearly broken and causing repeat confusion


Your job is not just to report problems.

Your job is to help create solutions.

You Should Be Able To Say:

“Here is the issue I am seeing. Here is the pattern. Here is what I recommend we do. Here is who needs to own it. Here is how I will track it.”

That is the level we need.


 Execution Tracking


You will help make sure the company has a clean system for tracking client requests, property issues, service updates, and internal follow-up.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Creating and updating tasks
Keeping CRM/client records clean
Tracking open issues by client/property
Maintaining follow-up dates and deadlines
Confirming completion instead of assuming completion
Helping leadership see what is open, stuck, urgent, or recurring
Preparing simple weekly reports on client issues, aging items, completed items, and recurring concerns
Making sure communication does not live only in someone’s memory, text thread, or random notebook


This role exists because “I think someone is handling it” is how businesses stay mediocre.

We are not doing that.


 Video Updates and Client Meetings


You must be comfortable on video.

This Role May Include:


Recording short Loom-style client updates
Showing your face on camera while explaining an update
Sharing your screen to walk through photos, notes, schedules, open items, or reports
Joining virtual meetings with clients
Joining internal team meetings
Helping create a more human, clear, and professional client experience


You do not need to be a news anchor.

Actually, please do not be a news anchor.

You need to be clear, confident, real, and professional.

Clients should feel like there is a smart human being paying attention.


 Bilingual Team Communication


This role requires strong English and Spanish.

You will often need to help communication flow between English-speaking clients or managers and Spanish-speaking field team members.

You Must Be Able To:


Write excellent English emails and updates
Speak clearly and professionally in English
Communicate effectively in Spanish
Clarify details between team members
Translate or summarize information accurately when needed
Avoid confusion caused by vague communication


Your English needs to be client-ready. Not “pretty good.” Not “I can get by.”

Client-ready.

Our Core Values and Mindset

We care a lot about fit. Skills matter, but mindset matters more.


 FITFO — Figure It The Freak Out


We need people who can think.

You will not always have perfect instructions. That is real life.

When something is unclear, we expect you to ask smart questions, look for context, make a recommendation, and keep moving.

Not panic.

Not disappear.

Not wait three days for someone to spoon-feed the answer.

Figure it out.


 Own It


Ownership means the problem does not have to be your fault for it to become your responsibility.

If a client issue lands with you, you own the communication loop until it is closed.

You do not get to say, “I sent it to operations” and wash your hands of it.

You follow up. You track. You confirm. You close the loop.


 Communicate Early and Honestly


Bad news early is useful.

Bad news late is expensive.

We do not need perfect updates. We need honest updates.

If something is delayed, say it clearly. If we made a mistake, communicate professionally. If you do not know yet, say what you are doing to find out and when the next update will happen.

Clients can handle issues.

They hate silence.


 No Dropped Balls


This role is for someone who hates loose ends.

You should be the kind of person who gets mildly annoyed when tasks are floating around with no owner, no due date, and no follow-up plan.

That annoyance is useful here.


 Calm Is a Superpower


Commercial landscaping can get messy.

Weather happens. Crews run late. Clients get frustrated. Irrigation breaks. Properties get missed. Someone forgets to send photos. A manager needs an answer now.

We need someone who stays calm, clear, and useful.

Drama does not help. Ownership does.


 Make the Company Better


We are not hiring you to maintain broken systems.

We are hiring you to help improve them.

If you see a better way to track issues, communicate updates, organize client notes, or prevent repeat problems, speak up and help build it.

What Success Looks Like

You Are Winning In This Role If:


Clients feel informed, respected, and taken care of
Client requests are usually resolved or meaningfully advanced within 72 hours
Open issues are tracked clearly with owners, due dates, and next steps
Clients receive proactive updates before they have to ask
Operations knows exactly what clients need and what is urgent
Recurring client issues are identified and escalated
Leadership can quickly see what is open, stuck, completed, or becoming a pattern
Client communication feels organized, human, and professional
Nothing important gets lost in email, text, WhatsApp, CRM notes, or someone’s brain
You make the business feel calmer, cleaner, and more accountable


Required Qualifications

Please do not apply unless you meet these requirements.


5+ years of customer service, client success, account management, operations coordination, executive assistant, or client-facing admin experience
3+ years working directly with U.S.-based clients or U.S.-based companies
2+ years working remotely in a role that required independent ownership and follow-up
Fluent written and spoken English at a professional, client-facing level
Fluent or highly advanced Spanish communication skills
Proven experience managing 50+ client/customer interactions, tickets, tasks, or follow-up items per week
Proven experience tracking issues through a CRM, help desk, project management tool, spreadsheet, or similar system
Ability to write clear client-facing updates with strong grammar, structure, and tone
Comfortable recording video updates with yourself on camera
Comfortable joining virtual client meetings
Comfortable making phone calls or voice calls when needed
Strong organization skills with a real personal system for tracking work
Strong ability to identify problems, recommend solutions, and follow through
Must be available during core U.S. business hours


Preferred Qualifications

These are not all required, but they are a big plus.


Experience in landscaping, construction, property management, home services, trades, field services, facilities management, or another service business
Experience supporting commercial clients or property managers
Experience with work orders, service tickets, scheduling, estimates, invoicing, or job tracking
Experience using Loom or similar video tools
Experience using CRMs, help desk systems, or project management software
Experience creating client reports or leadership updates
Experience working with bilingual field teams
Experience improving a process, not just following one


Tools You May Use

Gmail / Google Workspace
Google Sheets
CRM systems
Jobber, Aspire, LMN, Service Autopilot, Yardbook, HubSpot, Monday.com, ClickUp, or similar platforms
Loom or similar video recording tools
Slack, WhatsApp, or other internal messaging tools
Zoom / Google Meet
QuickBooks or other invoicing systems
Client portals or work order systems


If learning a new tool stresses you out, this is probably not your seat.

Who This Role Is Perfect For

This Role Is Perfect For Someone Who:


Loves creating order out of chaos
Takes pride in being the person who actually follows through
Can handle a frustrated client without getting defensive
Knows how to be warm without being fluffy
Knows how to be direct without being rude
Can manage a lot of moving pieces
Notices when something feels off
Is willing to chase an answer until the answer exists
Can lead from a remote seat
Wants to be part of building something much bigger and better than a normal landscaping company


Who This Role Is NOT For

This Role Is Not For Someone Who:


Needs to be told what to do all day
Waits quietly when something is unclear
Gets overwhelmed by multiple open tasks
Avoids difficult conversations
Is uncomfortable on camera
Writes sloppy English
Says “I’ll check on that” and then forgets
Thinks forwarding a message counts as ownership
Does not like systems, tracking, or follow-up
Wants a simple inbox-only customer service job


This is a leadership support role. You will have help, but you must bring brainpower, ownership, and urgency.

How to apply

We know your CV might not be up to date. Send what you have.

You'll be asked a few questions. Specific, numbers-based answers are expected. This helps us filter the best candidates at early stages of the process. If you have the right experience and you put the effort, it will be noticed. Vague answers won't move forward.

About the job

1.) Introduction

Job Title: Guest Experience & Escalations Specialist
Work Hours or Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week (EST time zone)
Location or Remote Status: Remote (LATAM)




2.) Overview

Turn high-stakes property challenges into seamless guest triumphs.

We are a premier property management company dedicated to delivering high-quality guest experiences across our diverse portfolio. Operating at the intersection of hospitality and real estate, we pride ourselves on maintaining exceptional guest satisfaction through rapid problem-solving, seamless coordination, and top-tier communication.

In this vital role, you will serve as our champion problem-solver. You will step in to handle complex guest situations, manage high-priority escalations, coordinate critical relocations, and bridge the gap between our internal departments and the people we serve. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment where your quick thinking directly impacts customer happiness, you will fit right in.




3.) Key Responsibilities

Handle escalated guest issues via phone, SMS, and email in a professional and timely manner.
Review internal unit notes and respond to guest inquiries based on available information.
Liaise with local operations teams to resolve guest concerns efficiently.
Initiate, manage, and complete last-minute and mid-stay guest relocations.
Assign and manage relocation work orders, ensuring timely execution and follow-through.
Coordinate with internal departments (Finance, Acquisitions, Field Operations, Legal, etc.) on relocation-related matters.
Support disaster-related guest relocations and coordinate future stay credits.
Assist with reservation management tasks, including rate adjustments and financial tools.
Perform additional administrative and operational support tasks as needed.




4.) Must-Have Requirements

Previous experience in customer support, guest services, or property management.
Strong written and verbal communication skills (highly professional tone required).
Experience handling escalations and resolving complex customer issues.
Ability to multitask and manage time-sensitive situations effectively.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Comfortable working cross-functionally with multiple teams.
Tech-savvy and able to learn internal systems quickly.




5.) Nice-to-Have Requirements

Experience in hospitality, short-term rentals, or property management platforms.
Familiarity with reservation systems and financial tools.
Experience managing relocations or logistics coordination.




6.) Why Join Us

Every day brings a unique puzzle to solve, and your work will have a tangible impact on our property portfolio and the people who stay with us. You will join a supportive, collaborative environment where you get to work cross-functionally with teams like Finance, Acquisitions, and Legal; giving you fantastic exposure to the inner workings of a growing business. If you are looking for a role where your empathy meets your execution skills, and where no two days are the same, we want to hear from you. Dive in and help us redefine the standard for modern guest experiences!

description:
About the job
This job is sourced from a job board. Learn More

This job is open to candidates working remotely from anywhere
Schedule: You must be available during core U.S. business hours, especially mornings and early afternoons when client, field, and operations communication is most active. Exact schedule will be discussed during the interview process
Compensation: 1250 USD/month first 90 days, 1500 USD/month after that. Bonus to be established after 90 day onboarding, bonus range of 8000 USD every 12 months
Commercial Landscaping Business | Remote via ScaleSource | Bilingual English/Spanish


Do you think you are a fit for this role but decided not to apply? Please tell us why.

About Us

We are a growing commercial landscaping company serving property managers, HOAs, multifamily communities, retail centers, office parks, business owners, and other commercial clients.

Yes, we mow grass, clean beds, trim shrubs, fix irrigation, handle seasonal color, and keep properties looking sharp.

But the real business we are in is trust.

Our clients are busy. They do not want to babysit their landscaping company. They do not want to send the same email three times. They do not want vague updates. They do not want “let me check on that” followed by silence.

They want someone who owns the issue, communicates clearly, follows through, and makes their life easier.

That is what this role is for.

We are hiring a Client Success / Customer Experience Lead who can help us build a client experience that is way better than what most local service businesses deliver.

This is a remote role through ScaleSource, but this is not a low-level assistant role. This is a leadership-level communication, execution, and follow-up seat.

You will be expected to think, lead, solve, track, follow up, and make sure things actually get done.

If you need to be told every step, this is not the role.

If you see problems, organize chaos, chase answers, communicate clearly, and make sure the ball does not get dropped, you may be exactly who we need.

The Big Picture

Our Standard Is Simple:

No client should ever have to wonder where something stands.

If a client has a question, complaint, issue, request, project update, scheduling concern, irrigation problem, billing question, or property concern, we need that item captured, clarified, assigned, tracked, updated, and completed.

Our goal is that most client issues or requests are resolved within 72 hours or less.

Next day is better.

Same day is beautiful.

But even when something cannot be solved immediately, the client should still receive clear, honest, proactive updates so they know we are on it.

We do not need someone who says, “I passed the message along.”

We Need Someone Who Says:

“I found the issue, confirmed who owns it, tracked the next step, updated the client, followed up with operations, and confirmed it was completed.”

That is the difference.

Role Mission

Your mission is to help us deliver world-class communication and client experience in a business where things move fast, weather changes plans, crews are in the field, clients have urgent needs, and details can easily get lost.

You will be the person helping make sure they do not get lost.

You will work between clients, field leadership, operations, admin, and ownership to make sure communication is clear and execution is tracked.

You are not just answering emails.

You are helping lead the customer experience.

What You’ll Own1. Client Communication

You will communicate with commercial clients through email, phone, text, client portals, CRM systems, video updates, and virtual meetings.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Responding to client messages quickly and professionally
Sending clear updates before clients have to chase us
Explaining what happened, what we are doing, who is responsible, and when the next update will happen
Communicating delays, weather issues, scheduling changes, property concerns, and service updates
Making clients feel heard without overpromising nonsense we cannot deliver
Keeping communication honest, calm, warm, and professional
Making us feel like the most organized landscaping company they have ever worked with


The goal is not to sound fancy.

The goal is to be clear, useful, trustworthy, and fast.


 Issue Ownership and 72-Hour Follow-Through


When a client reports an issue, you do not just forward it and hope someone handles it.

You own the communication loop until the item is completed.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Capturing the issue clearly
Asking good questions when the request is vague
Confirming property, location, priority, photos, timing, and client expectation
Assigning or escalating the issue to the correct internal person
Tracking the status until completion
Following up with operations or field leadership
Updating the client proactively
Confirming completion with notes, photos, or internal confirmation when possible
Closing the loop so everyone knows the issue was handled


Our standard is that client asks and issues should be completed or clearly moved forward within 72 hours whenever possible.

If something will take longer, the client still gets a real update.

No disappearing.

No vague “checking on it.”

No black holes.


 Problem Identification and Solutions


This role requires leadership judgment.

You should be able to identify patterns and problems before they become bigger problems.

For Example:


A client keeps asking about the same issue
A property keeps having the same service complaint
A crew keeps missing the same detail
A work order is stuck with no update
A client has not heard from us in too long
A property manager seems frustrated even if they are being polite
A process is clearly broken and causing repeat confusion


Your job is not just to report problems.

Your job is to help create solutions.

You Should Be Able To Say:

“Here is the issue I am seeing. Here is the pattern. Here is what I recommend we do. Here is who needs to own it. Here is how I will track it.”

That is the level we need.


 Execution Tracking


You will help make sure the company has a clean system for tracking client requests, property issues, service updates, and internal follow-up.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Creating and updating tasks
Keeping CRM/client records clean
Tracking open issues by client/property
Maintaining follow-up dates and deadlines
Confirming completion instead of assuming completion
Helping leadership see what is open, stuck, urgent, or recurring
Preparing simple weekly reports on client issues, aging items, completed items, and recurring concerns
Making sure communication does not live only in someone’s memory, text thread, or random notebook


This role exists because “I think someone is handling it” is how businesses stay mediocre.

We are not doing that.


 Video Updates and Client Meetings


You must be comfortable on video.

This Role May Include:


Recording short Loom-style client updates
Showing your face on camera while explaining an update
Sharing your screen to walk through photos, notes, schedules, open items, or reports
Joining virtual meetings with clients
Joining internal team meetings
Helping create a more human, clear, and professional client experience


You do not need to be a news anchor.

Actually, please do not be a news anchor.

You need to be clear, confident, real, and professional.

Clients should feel like there is a smart human being paying attention.


 Bilingual Team Communication


This role requires strong English and Spanish.

You will often need to help communication flow between English-speaking clients or managers and Spanish-speaking field team members.

You Must Be Able To:


Write excellent English emails and updates
Speak clearly and professionally in English
Communicate effectively in Spanish
Clarify details between team members
Translate or summarize information accurately when needed
Avoid confusion caused by vague communication


Your English needs to be client-ready. Not “pretty good.” Not “I can get by.”

Client-ready.

Our Core Values and Mindset

We care a lot about fit. Skills matter, but mindset matters more.


 FITFO — Figure It The Freak Out


We need people who can think.

You will not always have perfect instructions. That is real life.

When something is unclear, we expect you to ask smart questions, look for context, make a recommendation, and keep moving.

Not panic.

Not disappear.

Not wait three days for someone to spoon-feed the answer.

Figure it out.


 Own It


Ownership means the problem does not have to be your fault for it to become your responsibility.

If a client issue lands with you, you own the communication loop until it is closed.

You do not get to say, “I sent it to operations” and wash your hands of it.

You follow up. You track. You confirm. You close the loop.


 Communicate Early and Honestly


Bad news early is useful.

Bad news late is expensive.

We do not need perfect updates. We need honest updates.

If something is delayed, say it clearly. If we made a mistake, communicate professionally. If you do not know yet, say what you are doing to find out and when the next update will happen.

Clients can handle issues.

They hate silence.


 No Dropped Balls


This role is for someone who hates loose ends.

You should be the kind of person who gets mildly annoyed when tasks are floating around with no owner, no due date, and no follow-up plan.

That annoyance is useful here.


 Calm Is a Superpower


Commercial landscaping can get messy.

Weather happens. Crews run late. Clients get frustrated. Irrigation breaks. Properties get missed. Someone forgets to send photos. A manager needs an answer now.

We need someone who stays calm, clear, and useful.

Drama does not help. Ownership does.


 Make the Company Better


We are not hiring you to maintain broken systems.

We are hiring you to help improve them.

If you see a better way to track issues, communicate updates, organize client notes, or prevent repeat problems, speak up and help build it.

What Success Looks Like

You Are Winning In This Role If:


Clients feel informed, respected, and taken care of
Client requests are usually resolved or meaningfully advanced within 72 hours
Open issues are tracked clearly with owners, due dates, and next steps
Clients receive proactive updates before they have to ask
Operations knows exactly what clients need and what is urgent
Recurring client issues are identified and escalated
Leadership can quickly see what is open, stuck, completed, or becoming a pattern
Client communication feels organized, human, and professional
Nothing important gets lost in email, text, WhatsApp, CRM notes, or someone’s brain
You make the business feel calmer, cleaner, and more accountable


Required Qualifications

Please do not apply unless you meet these requirements.


5+ years of customer service, client success, account management, operations coordination, executive assistant, or client-facing admin experience
3+ years working directly with U.S.-based clients or U.S.-based companies
2+ years working remotely in a role that required independent ownership and follow-up
Fluent written and spoken English at a professional, client-facing level
Fluent or highly advanced Spanish communication skills
Proven experience managing 50+ client/customer interactions, tickets, tasks, or follow-up items per week
Proven experience tracking issues through a CRM, help desk, project management tool, spreadsheet, or similar system
Ability to write clear client-facing updates with strong grammar, structure, and tone
Comfortable recording video updates with yourself on camera
Comfortable joining virtual client meetings
Comfortable making phone calls or voice calls when needed
Strong organization skills with a real personal system for tracking work
Strong ability to identify problems, recommend solutions, and follow through
Must be available during core U.S. business hours


Preferred Qualifications

These are not all required, but they are a big plus.


Experience in landscaping, construction, property management, home services, trades, field services, facilities management, or another service business
Experience supporting commercial clients or property managers
Experience with work orders, service tickets, scheduling, estimates, invoicing, or job tracking
Experience using Loom or similar video tools
Experience using CRMs, help desk systems, or project management software
Experience creating client reports or leadership updates
Experience working with bilingual field teams
Experience improving a process, not just following one


Tools You May Use

You do not need to know all of these, but you need to be tech-comfortable and able to learn quickly.


Gmail / Google Workspace
Google Sheets
CRM systems
Jobber, Aspire, LMN, Service Autopilot, Yardbook, HubSpot, Monday.com, ClickUp, or similar platforms
Loom or similar video recording tools
Slack, WhatsApp, or other internal messaging tools
Zoom / Google Meet
QuickBooks or other invoicing systems
Client portals or work order systems


If learning a new tool stresses you out, this is probably not your seat.

Who This Role Is Perfect For

This Role Is Perfect For Someone Who:


Loves creating order out of chaos
Takes pride in being the person who actually follows through
Can handle a frustrated client without getting defensive
Knows how to be warm without being fluffy
Knows how to be direct without being rude
Can manage a lot of moving pieces
Notices when something feels off
Is willing to chase an answer until the answer exists
Can lead from a remote seat
Wants to be part of building something much bigger and better than a normal landscaping company


Who This Role Is NOT For

This Role Is Not For Someone Who:


Needs to be told what to do all day
Waits quietly when something is unclear
Gets overwhelmed by multiple open tasks
Avoids difficult conversations
Is uncomfortable on camera
Writes sloppy English
Says “I’ll check on that” and then forgets
Thinks forwarding a message counts as ownership
Does not like systems, tracking, or follow-up
Wants a simple inbox-only customer service job


This is a leadership support role. You will have help, but you must bring brainpower, ownership, and urgency.

How to apply

We know your CV might not be up to date. Send what you have.

You'll be asked a few questions. Specific, numbers-based answers are expected. This helps us filter the best candidates at early stages of the process. If you have the right experience and you put the effort, it will be noticed. Vague answers won't move forward.

A short video submission might be required at the right stage of the process.

Everyone gets a response within 24 business hours.

About the job

Role: Customer Support Specialist (Remote)
Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)
Job Type: Contract
Payout: $30 - $34/hour




Role Overview:

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking an AI Customer Support Specialist to work on a contract basis. This role requires expertise in troubleshooting AI tools and resolving customer issues related to AI-driven products. The position involves assisting users with platform-specific AI functionalities and ensuring seamless customer experiences.




Key Responsibilities:

• Respond to customer inquiries about AI tool functionality and usage through chat, email, and ticketing systems.

• Troubleshoot technical issues related to AI models, APIs, or platform integrations.

• Document recurring customer issues and escalate complex problems to engineering teams.

• Provide detailed solutions and step-by-step guidance for AI-related workflows.

• Monitor customer feedback to identify trends and suggest improvements for AI tool usability.




Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Experience providing customer support for AI tools or platforms is required.

• Proficiency in troubleshooting technical issues related to AI models or APIs is required.

• Ability to explain complex AI concepts in simple, actionable terms is required.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills are required.

• Familiarity with ticketing systems and CRM tools is preferred.




More About the Opportunity:

This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Technology, Information and Internet industry, contributing to enhanced customer experiences with AI-driven solutions. The position provides exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies and their real-world applications.




Equal Opportunity Employer:

We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications.




Apply Now!

About the job

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

Only applications of candidates with Mexican citizenship will be evaluated for this role in compliance with the provisions of Article 7 of the Federal Labor Law.

Minimum qualifications:


Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in marketing, brand management, strategy consulting, agency, technology, or related fields through full time roles, internships, projects, or academic classes.


Preferred qualifications:


Experience in marketing.
Knowledgeable about and passion for Google's products, technology and leadership in the artificial intelligence (AI) space.
Excellent program management and communication skills.
 Excellent analytical and problem-solving and communication skills with demonstrated attention to detail.
 Demonstrated interest in marketing, brand management, strategy consulting, agency, AI, technology, or related fields.


About the jobWhether you're on a consumer product (like Gmail, Search, Maps, Chrome, Android) or a business product (Google Ads, AdSense, Google Marketing Platform, Analytics), you take part in a complete marketing experience as you lead every facet of the product's journey. From determining positioning, naming, competitive analysis, feature prioritization and external communications, you help shape the product and help it grow a consumer base. This means you work with a cross-functional team across Sales, corporate communications, legal, webmasters, product development, engineering and more. In this role, you'll be involved with product marketing strategy from beginning to end.

As an Associate Product Marketing Manager (APMM), you will be part of the APMM Program, Google’s global program for early career Marketers. You will work on priority marketing projects in your organisation, develop a breadth of marketing skills, join a strong community of peers and alumni, and be supported by dedicated mentors and senior leaders. In addition to your core work, you are expected to complete learning and development milestones, attend APMM programming, and actively contribute to the APMM community.

Define and execute go-to-market strategies and campaigns for new product or feature launches and measure effectiveness against Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
Develop programs aimed at acquiring customers including business strategies, messaging, collateral, events, increasing our engagement with them and measuring the efficacy of such programs.
Support team in evaluating product and feature improvements to better meet user needs, product readiness for launch, and communicate the new developments to users.
Craft client and executive narratives, presentations, case studies, and content designed to accelerate the business momentum to better engage Google's customers and agency partners.
Execute marketing related tasks within the scope of larger products or projects, under the guidance from the manager.

title: Travel Designer
description:
About the job

About the Role

As a Travel Designer, you are responsible for transforming each member's travel dreams, preferences, and aspirations into exceptional, tailor-made journeys that feel effortless, thoughtful, and deeply personal.

Working within a Pod that operates as a business unit, you will combine curiosity, creativity, commercial awareness, and outstanding communication skills to design experiences that delight members while contributing to the Pod's commercial success.

You will report directly to the Experience Manager, who provides your day-to-day leadership, sets priorities, and supports your performance and professional growth.

You will partner closely with the Travel Design Lead, who is responsible for establishing travel design standards, coaching the team, and ensuring every itinerary and proposal consistently meets the quality standards.

You will also collaborate closely with the Destination Team, leveraging their expertise to create exceptional journeys while contributing your own insights and feedback to continuously improve destination knowledge, experiences, and recommendations.

Together, you will collaborate across the Pod to deliver the level of personalization, attention to detail, commercial impact, and service excellence.

 




Your Areas of Ownership




Member Understanding

● Collaborate closely with the Experience Manager to develop a deep understanding of each member's travel style, preferences, priorities, and aspirations.

● Demonstrate curiosity by asking the right questions and proactively seeking the context needed to design highly personalized journeys.

● Translate member profiles and insights into thoughtful recommendations that accurately reflect each member's needs, preferences, and expectations.

● Apply empathy, active listening, and exceptional attention to detail to ensure every itinerary feels personal, relevant, and carefully crafted.

● Demonstrate sound judgment by delivering recommendations that are accurate, relevant, and fully aligned with the member's needs, budget, preferences, and expectations.

 

Travel Design Excellence

● Design highly personalized journeys that combine creativity, attention to detail, and operational feasibility.

● Craft itineraries that reflect each member's lifestyle, interests, and travel aspirations.

● Work closely with the Destinations team to combine destination expertise with member insights, creating thoughtfully curated journeys that feel authentic, personalized, and truly exceptional.

● Deliver proposals that feel unique, thoughtful, and tailored to every member.

● Balance inspiration with practicality while maintaining Essentialist's standards of quality and luxury.

● Partner with the Travel Design Lead to continuously elevate the quality, creativity, and consistency of every itinerary and proposal.

● Continuously expand your destination knowledge and seek inspiration to create unforgettable travel experiences.

 

Commercial Impact

● Contribute to revenue growth by identifying opportunities to enrich every itinerary with meaningful experiences and additional services.

● Support trip conversion through timely responses, thoughtful recommendations, and compelling travel proposals.

● Balance creativity with commercial awareness, ensuring recommendations deliver value for both the member and the business.

● Recognize opportunities to surprise and delight members while strengthening long-term loyalty.

 




Destination Collaboration 

● Build strong relationships with the Destination Team to continuously deepen your destination knowledge.

● Partner closely with Destination Specialists to ensure every itinerary reflects local expertise, operational feasibility, and the highest quality standards.

● Share feedback on destinations, suppliers, and experiences to help continuously improve recommendations and travel content.

● Proactively identify gaps, inconsistencies, or opportunities for improvement and collaborate with the Destination Team to strengthen future itineraries.

● Contribute to building and evolving destination's knowledge by sharing learnings and insights from your member interactions.

 

Operational Excellence

● Respond promptly to member requests and internal priorities, maintaining speed without compromising quality.

● Manage multiple trips simultaneously while consistently meeting turnaround expectations and service standards.

● Translate member needs into clear, structured, and actionable plans for the Operations team.

● Build accurate, complete, and operationally feasible itineraries by working closely with the Destination Team and leveraging their expertise.

● Maintain exceptional attention to detail across every stage of the travel design process, ensuring every proposal meets the quality standards.

 

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

● Partner closely with your Experience Manager, Operations Executives, Travel Design Lead, and Destination Team to deliver exceptional member experiences.

● Collaborate with the Destination Team to ensure every itinerary reflects local expertise, operational feasibility, and the highest quality standards.

● Proactively share feedback, identify gaps, and suggest improvements to destination content, supplier recommendations, and travel experiences, helping continuously strengthen the destination knowledge.

● Maintain clear, proactive, and accurate communication with the Operations Executives, ensuring all information is transferred seamlessly to enable flawless trip execution.

● Collaborate openly across the Pod, embrace feedback, continuously develop your travel expertise, and contribute to raising the team's standards.

 

Qualifications / Requirements

● Proven experience in luxury travel, bespoke travel agencies, tour operators, DMCs, concierge services, or premium hospitality is required.

● Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.

● Exceptional curiosity and a genuine passion for travel, destinations, and cultures.

● Excellent attention to detail with the ability to interpret complex requests accurately.

● Strong commercial awareness and the ability to naturally identify opportunities to enhance both the member experience and business results.

● Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

● Excellent judgment, problem-solving skills, and decision-making ability.

● Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively within a cross-functional Pod structure.

● Comfortable adopting new tools, technology, and AI solutions that enhance efficiency, collaboration, and the overall member experience.

 

What Great Looks Like

Success as a Travel Designer means creating journeys that feel deeply personal, effortless, and unforgettable.

You will:

● Consistently design exceptional, highly personalized travel experiences.

● Develop a deep understanding of every member's preferences and travel aspirations.

● Respond quickly while maintaining outstanding quality and attention to detail.

● Deliver recommendations that are thoughtful, accurate, and commercially impactful.

● Build trusted partnerships within your Pod to ensure seamless execution.

● Continuously expand your travel knowledge and inspire members with exceptional ideas.

● Contribute to long-term member loyalty by creating experiences members can't wait to repeat.

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

We are looking for a Data oriented person with strong data analytic skills to support one of the TOP start-ups in the Food Delivery category across LATAM. In this position you will have the opportunity to create value by converting data into powerful insights to take key actions in the day-to-day Marketplace operations.

This role, will allow you to interact and collaborate with cross-functional teams like Pricing, Marketing, Product, Business Governance, Commercial and others within the Food Delivery ecosystem. By being part of the Delivery Marketplace team you will manage city portfolios with a best-in-class approach across the markets DiDi operates.

As our data-driving team member, you should have a background and advanced skills in SQL, Excel, and Python as well as sound business acumen.

In this role, you'll be...


Build scalable operations processes focused on driving growth and efficiency
Design engagement strategies to increase and retain the number of couriers on our platform, as well as their online connection time
Generate data insights and work cross-functionally with departments such as Supply Growth, Business Governance, Courier Structure, Marketing, CX, and various regional operations teams
Turn raw data into actionable opportunities using visualization and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, R, and big data platforms
Conduct research and analysis to produce clear evidence of the effectiveness and efficiency of product and operations initiatives
Build and maintain detailed reporting models, including core OKRs and growth funnels, to support city-level, regional, and market-wide consolidation efforts
Recommend changes to improve city performance across Mexico and regional markets, guided by the Marketplace pillars
Ensure data cleanliness and consistency to support sound analysis and decision-making
Document best practices to promote consistency and continuous improvement across the business unit and the company
Support the product team by providing input and feedback on new features and assignment models



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


2 to 4 years of professional experience in consulting, operations, analytics, technology, or as an analyst
A degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Business or a related field
Problem-solving: Skilled at gathering data, executing analysis, and structuring information to drive solutions
Technical skills: Proven experience with tools such as Excel, SQL, Python, and Google or Microsoft suites
Ownership: Strong prioritization skills, a feedback-driven mindset, and an owner mentality
Risk and ambiguity: Comfortable navigating uncertainty and taking calculated risks through innovative approaches
Analytical thinking: Demonstrated aptitude for analytical and conceptual problem-solving, with comfort handling quantitative analysis
Communication: Ability to convey complex ideas clearly, both verbally and in writing
Attention to detail: Detail-oriented, with a strong desire to learn
Teamwork: Strong collaboration skills and emotional maturity
Language: English proficiency to communicate with teams across DiDi's global operations



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.
